152. fn is_payload_item(val: &str) -> Result<Option<PayloadItem>, String> {
153.     let item: Vec<&str> = val.split('=').collect();
154. 
155.     match item.len() {
156.         2 => Ok(PayloadItem::from_string_with_name(
157.             Some(&String::from(item[1])),
158.             item[0],
159.         )),
160.         _ => Err(String::from(
161.             "payloads must have a key and value in the form key=value",
162.         )),
163.     }
164. }
165. 
166. fn is_timestamp_or_duration(val: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
167.     match val.parse::<i64>() {
168.         Ok(_) => Ok(val.into()),
169.         Err(_) => match parse_duration_string(val) {
170.             Ok(_) => Ok(val.into()),
171.             Err(_) => Err(String::from(
172.                 "must be a UNIX timestamp or systemd.time string",
173.             )),
174.         },
175.     }
176. }

179.     match alg {

181.         SupportedAlgorithms::HS384 => Algorithm::HS384,
182.         SupportedAlgorithms::HS512 => Algorithm::HS512,
183.         SupportedAlgorithms::RS256 => Algorithm::RS256,
184.         SupportedAlgorithms::RS384 => Algorithm::RS384,
185.         SupportedAlgorithms::RS512 => Algorithm::RS512,
186.         SupportedAlgorithms::PS256 => Algorithm::PS256,
187.         SupportedAlgorithms::PS384 => Algorithm::PS384,
188.         SupportedAlgorithms::PS512 => Algorithm::PS512,
189.         SupportedAlgorithms::ES256 => Algorithm::ES256,
190.         SupportedAlgorithms::ES384 => Algorithm::ES384,
191.     }
192. }
